identity.name: Arab News
identity.description: Saudi Arabia's English-language daily, covering Saudi and Gulf politics, business and regional affairs for diplomats and executives.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Saudi Research and Media Group, a publicly traded Saudi media company with state-linked shareholders and close proximity to official Saudi communications.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Coverage closely tracks Saudi official positions and avoids sustained criticism of the Saudi government; SRMG has state-linked ownership.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Right-Center and Mixed factual reporting; socially conservative and pro-Saudi establishment.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, energy markets and Gulf investment flows.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames regional affairs through Saudi state priorities and Gulf cooperation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mixed and credibility Low; useful for official Saudi perspectives but weak as an independent check.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Right-Center; factual reporting Mixed; credibility Low (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Saudi establishment voice. Explains Gulf affairs through official Saudi priorities, Vision 2030 and regional diplomacy, with limited adversarial reporting on the kingdom.

selectionRationale: Provides a Saudi official-perspective source, but its blocked feed and low independent credibility make it a monitoring-only addition.

feeds.validationNote: 50 items; valid RSS returning current items with production User-Agent headers.

research.researchNotes: Existing production feed is Cloudflare-blocked. Activation recommendation: monitor only; do not treat as validated. MBFC credibility is Low. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
